summary: Vietnam veteran Bill Cooper spread UFO and New World Order conspiracy theories through early online forums, his book Behold a Pale Horse and shortwave radio, fed the 1990s US militia movement, abused a string of wives, and died in a 2001 shootout with Arizona deputies.
keywords: Protocols of the Elders of Zion

riverboat posting in Quang Tri province during the Vietnam War

John Lear's alien-deal hypothesis and his partnership with Cooper
writing and 1991 publication of Behold a Pale Horse

McVeigh and the Nichols brothers as listeners before Oklahoma City

notes: Transcript says Cooper shot an officer dead in the 2001 raid; my understanding is the deputy was wounded, so the summary avoids the claim. main_span start of 1988 is inferred (year garbled in transcript).
